name: membral
description: Your coding agent can answer from what your past sessions found. Uploads each Claude Code session to Membral when it ends, adds a short memory preamble when a session starts, and connects the Membral MCP server.

api_url.title: Membral server URL
api_url.description: http://localhost:3000 for `membral local up` (no trailing slash).

api_key.title: Membral API key
api_key.description: From `membral local up` output, or your server's Settings → Keys.
